semantic_repairs_applied.description: Implemented _verify_path_components_non_symlink in probe.py. Walks and verifies each intermediate directory component (e.g. 1m, year=YYYY, month=MM) using non-following os.lstat before child access. Immediately raises ProbeSecurityError upon encountering any symbolic link.

Replaced naive prefix checks with os.path.commonpath to prevent root escape attacks (e.g. data-v2, ../). Replaced os.path.exists() preflight with os.lstat() to prevent silent symlink resolution of data_root.

Removed broad Exception catches (BLE001). ProbeSecurityError and ProbeBudgetExceededError now strictly propagate without suppression. PermissionError is distinguished as PERMISSION_DENIED and never collapsed into ENOENT/missing.

Hardened scandir loop: removed except Exception: pass (S110), added traversal and protected pattern rejection for candidate filenames, fixed unused unpack variable full_p (RUF059), and ensured budget exceptions propagate out.

Added allow_custom_root parameter to OwnerRootProbe. Production runs strictly reject any root other than /root/workspace/project/Quant-agent/data, while synthetic temporary test fixtures explicitly enable allow_custom_root=True.
Resolved all 20 Ruff violations (I001, RUF022, F401, F541, ISC004, BLE001, RUF059, UP017) across own codebase without blanket noqa suppression.
